name: Ahmad Ashfaq
role: Web Developer · Video Editor · Graphic Designer
tagline: I build the sites you launch on and cut the reels you launch with.
bio: I'm a Fiverr Level 1 Seller with 2+ years of freelance experience shipping polished websites, short-form edits, and brand visuals for clients who need work that performs, not just looks nice. I move between three disciplines — code, edit, and design — so every project I touch gets treated like a single connected piece, not three separate hand-offs.

services.title: Web Development

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: Story-driven edits for YouTube, podcasts, and long-form content — paced, color-graded, and sound-designed to hold attention.

services.title: Short-Form & Reels
services.description: Scroll-stopping vertical edits for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts — hooks, captions, and pacing built for retention.

services.title: Graphic Design
services.description: Thumbnails, ad creative, and brand visuals that stop the scroll and stay on-brand across every platform.
